Class OWItem

java.lang.Object
tripleo.vendor.thinlet.objectwrapper.OWObject
tripleo.vendor.thinlet.objectwrapper.OWItem
Direct Known Subclasses:
Cell, Choice, Column, Item, Menu, MenuItem, Node, Tab
public abstract class OWItem extends OWObject
OWItem represent a complex item used by widget, as the ComboBox choice, list item, menu item, or tree node
